entries.63419644582b0960: The company states that its management policy is to contribute to the realization of a sustainable society by creating technologies and products based on chemistry and providing value to society as a whole, not only in the pharmaceutical and advanced technology fields. The company states that, drawing on its bromination and iodination technologies as strengths, it will advance environmental compliance and conformity with global standards, and work on new technology development and the opening of new fields through proposals of high-function, high-value-added products. The group medium-term plan (fiscal years 2024-2027) positions fiscal years 2024-2025 as a business restructuring period and fiscal years 2026-2027 as a business expansion period, but the company states that, due to the situation in the Middle East and higher raw material prices, a large gap has arisen between the plan’s assumptions and actual conditions, and that it is considering a review of the plan to bring it in line with actual conditions.
